A live cell stays live with exactly two or three live neighbors; a dead cell becomes live with exactly three. All updates use the original grid. Return next grid and coordinates [row,column] that changed in row-major order.

prompt:
Read input.json and write output.json containing the JSON result specified here. Preserve input.json.
Quantize a sequence of nonnegative rational samples with error feedback. Samples are [numerator,positive denominator]. Start residual zero. For each sample compute adjusted=sample+residual; emit floor(adjusted+1/2), then residual=adjusted-emitted. Return integer levels and final residual as a reduced [numerator,denominator]. This is sequential quantization: do not round samples independently or reset residual.

files.policy.md: Order pending disk requests under this LOOK scheduler. Start at the supplied cylinder facing up. Among unfinished requests at or above the current cylinder choose the nearest, tie by request ID. If none exists, reverse direction and choose the nearest at or below. Continue in that direction until no pending request remains in it, then reverse. A request exactly at the head is eligible in either direction. No new arrivals occur. Return request IDs in service order and final head cylinder. Do not travel to cylinder boundaries.
